q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The question asks about forward guidance issued at the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026. Today is August 25, 2026, so resolution occurs in approximately **1 day**.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for **forward guidance** on revenue, which in this context means guidance for **Q3 FY2027** (the next quarter), not Q2 actual results. The research clearly indicates:

- Q3 FY2027 consensus analyst estimate: **$103.8 billion**
- UBS expectation for Q3 guidance: **$107-108 billion** (described as "comfortably ahead" of consensus)
- The research emphasizes that Q3 guidance will be the key driver of stock reaction

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA issues Q3 guidance in the **$107-108 billion range**, as flagged by UBS. This would represent approximately 3-4% above Wall Street consensus, which is consistent with NVIDIA's historical pattern of providing forward guidance slightly ahead of analyst expectations while maintaining conservative execution.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Macro deterioration or demand slowdown** — unexpected weakness in AI/data center spending could prompt more conservative guidance
- **China revenue constraints remaining** — the research notes guidance assumes zero China data center revenue; if regulatory uncertainties persist, NVIDIA may not add incremental upside
- **Supply chain issues** — any manufacturing or supply constraints could reduce production capacity for Q3
- **Competitive pressures** — increased competition from AMD or others could pressure demand expectations
- **Conservative guidance strategy** — NVIDIA could guide lower to ensure beat probability

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Stronger-than-expected demand** — accelerating AI/GenAI adoption could drive higher utilization and orders
- **Better supply position** — if manufacturing ramped faster than expected, capacity could support higher shipments
- **China approval catalyst** — any approved data center revenue from China would be "upside" (per research), driving higher guidance
- **Customer pull-ins** — major cloud/enterprise customers front-loading orders could pull forward demand
- **Market share gains** — outperformance vs. competitive set could justify aggressive guidance

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q2 FY2027 NVIDIA guidance (May 2026): **~$91.0 billion** (range $89.2-$92.8 billion)
- Q2 Wall Street consensus: **$91.9-$92.07 billion** (essentially meeting/slightly beating company guidance)
- Q3 consensus: **$103.8 billion**
- Expected Q3 guidance range per UBS: **$107-108 billion**

The range given ($99.5-$115.5 billion) appears to encompass multiple possible Q3 guidance scenarios. The midpoint ($107.5 billion) aligns closely with the UBS expectation.

---

## Probability Distribution

The UBS note appears well-sourced and specific ($107-108 billion), representing a credible institutional view. The research indicates this is "comfortably ahead" of consensus ($103.8B), suggesting 3-4% upside is expected.

Given:
- High confidence in UBS view ($107-108B)
- Limited time until resolution (1 day)
- Strong analyst coverage and market expectations
- Historical pattern of NVIDIA meeting/slightly beating guidance

I estimate the median guidance will fall in the $107-108 billion range, with a reasonable band around this:

- **10th percentile (lower tail):** If macro concerns or more conservative positioning emerges → ~$102-104B
- **50th percentile (median):** UBS guidance expectation aligns well → ~$107.5B
- **90th percentile (upper tail):** If demand surprises to upside and China upside mentioned → ~$110-111B

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is set to report its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after the U.S. market close, with the analyst call following at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. While the Q2 results will be important, analysts widely expect the Q3 FY2027 revenue guidance to be the key driver for the stock's reaction [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

NVIDIA's own Q2 revenue guidance, issued in May 2026, is approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% (a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion) [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026). Wall Street consensus for Q2 revenue is slightly higher at $91.9 billion across roughly 60 analysts [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), or $92.07 billion across 41 analysts [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). This consensus is only about 1% above the company's guided midpoint [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

The consensus revenue for Q3 FY2027 (the October quarter) is $103.8 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). UBS is telling clients to expect NVIDIA to guide Q3 revenue to $107-108 billion, "comfortably ahead" of this consensus [aliteq.com](https://aliteq.com/nvidia-q2-fy27-earnings-preview-ubs-2026). It's crucial to note that NVIDIA's Q2 guidance, and likely the upcoming Q3 guidance, assumes no data center compute revenue from China, meaning any approved China sales would be upside [ig.com](https://www.ig.com/en-ch/news-and-trade-ideas/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview--what-to-watch-260825), [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/), [piptheory.com](https://piptheory.com/research/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-preview-august-2026).
